title: Poachers
writer: Manuel Gutiérrez Aragón, José Luis Borau
actors: Lola Gaos, Ovidi Montllor, Alicia Sánchez
plot: Angel is a poacher who lives in the forest with his domineering mother. One day he goes to the city and meets Milagros, an escapee from a reform school and the lover of a known criminal so he takes her to his house in the mountains.
